items.title: Kyle Monangai: Quiet in return to lineup
items.text:
Monangai carried the ball eight times for 18 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.

items.title: CeeDee Lamb: Gaudy totals again in win
items.text:
Lamb brought 11 of 12 targets for 132 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: D'Andre Swift: Retains top job with Monangai back
items.text:
Swift carried the ball 13 times for 51 yards and caught both his targets for eight yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Dak Prescott: Five total TDs for second straight week
items.text:
Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added four carries for nine yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Three TDs in 300-yard effort
items.text:
Mahomes completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
